steps.title: Open Claude Code
steps.body: Open the Claude Code app and sign in.

steps.title: Add an SSH connection
steps.body: Open the environment menu next to the prompt box and pick “Add SSH connection”.
steps.alt: Screenshot · environment menu with Add SSH connection

steps.title: Enter the details
steps.body: Host, port, user and key file. All four are in the card below — copy them one by one.
steps.alt: Screenshot · SSH connection form, filled in

steps.title: Start prompting
steps.body: Pick the projects folder and tell it what to build.
steps.alt: Screenshot · Claude Code prompt, connected to the kitchen

steps.title: Open Claude Code
steps.body: Open the Claude Code app and sign in.

steps.title: Switch to WSL
steps.body: Open the environment menu next to the prompt box and pick WSL.

steps.title: Pick omelet-vm
steps.body: Choose the omelet-vm machine from the list.
steps.alt: Screenshot · WSL machine list with omelet-vm

steps.title: Start prompting
steps.body: Pick the projects folder and tell it what to build.
steps.alt: Screenshot · Claude Code prompt, connected to the kitchen
